Pleas of Pixies (3+)

Start NPC: Pixy Murika
Description:
Restrictions:
Repeatable: No
Last Hit: Solo
Reward:
 
1 Emerald,
1 Blue Onyx,
1 Onyx,
1 Glass Shard


Guide

Step
Description
1
Talk to Pixy Murika.
2
Hunt Young Red Keltir, Red Keltir, Elder Red Keltir and Gray Wolf to collect
100 Predator's Fang.
3
Give the
1 Predator's Fang to Pixy Murika, for a
1 Emerald,
1 Blue Onyx,
1 Onyx or an
1 Glass Shard.


Game Description

Step
Description
1
The Queen of the Pixies is preparing a spell to protect birds that are nesting in the Elven Forest from keltirs and wolves. Pixy Murika is under the Queen’s order to collect the needed ingredients. She asks for one hundred red keltir or gray wolf fangs. In return she will give you a sparkling stone that was found in the forest.
